lines.text: In this world, the penthouse is on the ground floor.
Because here, nobody ever invented the wheel.
No carts. No cars. Everything you buy arrives on someone's back.
So every city grew along a river. Boats were the only fast lane.
No wheel means no pulley. No pulley, no elevator.
So the higher you live, the more you climb. The poor live at the top.
No gears, so no clocks. Here, being late is measured in shadows.
Every year, someone invents the wheel again. And every year, the porters vote it out.
Which is exactly why, in this world...
